verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to integrate third-party, partner-built agent apps: there is no marketplace, partner app catalog, or app integration mechanism. What is documented are adjacent extension points: MCP server configs (client-side tool connections), custom tools, and overriding modes or subagents. These are developer building blocks, not support for partner-built agent apps, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
